description: Header file defining the ArrayRef class, a non-owning reference to an array, with utility functions and operators, used within the c10 namespace for tensor and array operations in PyTorch/LLVM infrastructure.

classes.name: ArrayRef
classes.description: A template class representing a non-owning reference to an array of elements of type T, with methods for access, slicing, and construction from various containers.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns the first element of the array reference, with a check for emptiness.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns the last element of the array reference, with a check for emptiness.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a sub-array starting at index N with length M, or from N to the end.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns the element at the specified index with bounds checking.
